evidence: Modifies public kernel headers and implementations in src/kernel/ to introduce structured log delivery and decouple logging.cpp from libbitcoinkernel.
rationale: Decouples libbitcoinkernel from node logging machinery while replacing brittle string parsing with structured log entries for downstream consumers. Reviewers note this rationalizes the kernel logging API, removes node-specific buffering and filtering from the kernel build, and unblocks downstream kernel milestones #30342 and #33847.
